from hamana import Query
from hamana.core.identifier import IntegerColumn, StringColumn, DateColumn

# Define the column schema
columns = [
    IntegerColumn(name="id"),
    StringColumn(name="name"),
    DateColumn(name="created_at", format="%Y-%m-%d"),
]

# Create the Query with explicit column schema
query = Query(
    query="SELECT id, name, created_at FROM users",
    columns=columns,
)

print(query)
